rows.label: PPP conversion factor (2017 international $ per US $)

source.title: World Bank, World Development Indicators: PPP conversion factor, household final consumption (PA.NUS.PRVT.PP) and official exchange rate (PA.NUS.FCRF)
source.note: Sudan, 2017: 5.4583 Sudanese pounds per international $ (household consumption PPP) and 6.6834 pounds per US$ (PA.NUS.FCRF); 6.6834 / 5.4583 = 1.2244 (WDI last updated 2026-10-08).

rows.explainer: How much more a US dollar buys in Sudan than in the US, at 2017 prices (household consumption PPP over the official exchange rate). In 2017 the official rate gave far fewer pounds per dollar than the parallel market, so this understates what a dollar of goods is worth there.

rows.label: Crude death rate, 2024 (deaths per person-year)

source.title: World Bank, World Development Indicators: Death rate, crude (per 1,000 people), SP.DYN.CDRT.IN (UN WPP)
source.note: Sudan, 2024: 6.335 deaths per 1,000 people (WDI last updated 2026-10-08); divided by 1,000.

rows.explainer: Deaths per person a year in the whole population, the normal rate a crisis's excess mortality is measured against.
